simple.summary: פָּאָה (pâʼâh) means to puff , i.e. blow away First listed occurrence: Deut 32 26.

definitions.full: H6284. paah [ מּאה ] verb perhaps (si vera lectio) cleave in pieces (Arabic (, ) cleave, split (head, bowl, etc.); Sabean פעי DHM ZMG xxx (1876), 701 f. ); — Hiph`il Imperfect 1singular suffix אַפְאֵיהֶם Deut 32:26 I [ ׳י ] will cleave them in pieces (possibly point ׳אֶפ , i.e. Qal ; on other views see Dr; read perhaps ᵐ5 אֲפִיצֵם Gr).
